text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wait, the people being interviewed in
this
article... It's those two men from
before. That
means... they came to
watch our race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"They ran the Nakayama turf
2,500-meter, which
has sharp turns and
includes six corners to make
things even
trickier. Aptitude is everything on a

course like that."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Where's this coming from?" Wow, they
haven't
changed. I miss the days when
we'd cheer side by
side, crying together,
celebrating together...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's our duty to deliver moments like
those to
fans. I'm going to share this with
Kita later. ♪
